context.goal: Make weekly client updates accurate and timely without adding overtime.
context.constraints: Use redacted material in discovery. Confirm tool and data permissions before a live test. No automatic customer messages.

ideas.title: Prepare weekly client updates
ideas.problem: Coordinators reconcile notes from three sources for each update. Missing commitments create rework and delay customer communication.
ideas.currentWork: Collect account notes, compare open issues, draft the update, and check every commitment before an account lead sends it.
ideas.proposedWork: An approved AI tool prepares a draft from permitted sources. The coordinator checks facts and omissions. The account lead approves and sends the update.
ideas.exclusions: No new customer commitments, direct sends, CRM write access, or staffing changes in this test.
ideas.outcome: Reduce net preparation time while maintaining accurate, complete client updates.
ideas.contribution: Identified the recurring handoff problem, mapped current work, and proposed a redacted discovery exercise. No implementation or achieved benefit is claimed.
ideas.businessOwner: Account operations lead — proposed, not yet accepted
ideas.collaborators: Account lead for content review; IT/security for access; operations analyst for timing; L&D for a short review checklist.
ideas.audiences: Coordinators change preparation and checking. Account leads retain approval. Customers experience the final update. IT/support handle access and exceptions.
ideas.learning: A checked example, a practice draft, a fact-check checklist, and a named escalation route for missing or conflicting commitments.
ideas.request: Authorize four weeks of discovery and a bounded test, subject to tool/data review, with two coordinators and one account lead. Confirm the owner, effort, and budget before starting.
ideas.quality: Every critical commitment is correct, sourced, and approved. No confidential material in an unapproved tool. Track omissions and rework, not just speed.
ideas.baselineSource: E01: fictional timing notes for six updates. The sample is illustrative and too small to establish a company-wide baseline.
ideas.testPlan: Confirm permissions, then time a comparable sample before and during a four-week test. Include drafting, checking, correction, and support. Have the account lead review quality using the same checklist.
ideas.stopRule: Pause for a confidentiality incident or a critical unsupported commitment. Rework the approach if it adds net effort. Expand only after the owner reviews quality, cost, and actual time data.
ideas.evidence: E01 — illustrative current timing. E02 — untested drafting/review estimates. E03 — tool/data permission unresolved. All example evidence is fictional.
ideas.selectionReason: A recurring workflow with a clear output and an identifiable reviewer. Start with discovery because approval and representative timing remain unresolved.

history.reason: Develop a discovery request. Keep the other opportunities for later.

ideas.title: Route recurring support questions
ideas.problem: Repeated questions move between account and support teams.
ideas.selectionReason: Retain for later. Needs evidence of frequency and routing failure before choosing a tool.

ideas.title: Consolidate account-status reporting
ideas.problem: Teams reconcile different versions of account status.
ideas.selectionReason: Investigate shared data definitions first. Existing reporting may be a better starting point than AI.
